```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(backgammonr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

This notebook keeps the allocation rule fixed at canonical Thompson sampling and changes the statistical model stack.

The two comparison functions are:

- `bg_compare_posteriors()` for one reward model with different posterior families.
- `bg_compare_reward_models()` for different coherent reward-model/posterior-model stacks.

```{r settings}
truth_budget <- 100000L
roll_1_6_truth_path <- file.path(
  "artifacts",
  "opening_truths",
  paste0("opening_1-6_truth_budget_", truth_budget, ".rds")
)

if (!file.exists(roll_1_6_truth_path)) {
  stop("Run 01_save_all_21_opening_truths.Rmd first so the 1-6 truth file exists.")
}

model_budgets <- c(16L, 32L, 64L, 128L, 256L, 512L)
model_seeds <- 1:25
model_overwrite <- FALSE

study_dir <- file.path("artifacts", "studies")
dir.create(study_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

posterior_compare_path <- file.path(
  study_dir,
  "opening_1-6_scalar_posterior_compare.rds"
)

reward_compare_path <- file.path(
  study_dir,
  "opening_1-6_reward_stack_compare.rds"
)

truth_1_6 <- bg_truth_load(roll_1_6_truth_path)

problem_1_6 <- bg_problem(
  state = bg_initial_board(),
  roll = bg_roll(1L, 6L),
  simulation_policy = "random",
  reward_model = "scalar_payoff",
  posterior_model = "beta_pseudo",
  problem_id = "opening_1-6"
)
```

```{r posterior-compare}
posterior_compare_1_6 <- bg_compare_posteriors(
  problems = problem_1_6,
  reward_model = "scalar_payoff",
  posterior_models = c("beta_pseudo", "student_t_marginal", "bootstrap"),
  budgets = model_budgets,
  seeds = model_seeds,
  allocation_policy = "thompson",
  proxy_references = truth_1_6$reference,
  save_path = posterior_compare_path,
  overwrite = model_overwrite
)
```

```{r posterior-summary}
knitr::kable(
  posterior_compare_1_6$summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Posterior-family comparison for scalar-payoff Thompson sampling."
)
```

```{r posterior-eval}
posterior_eval <- bg_eval_reference_aware(
  posterior_compare_1_6,
  truth = truth_1_6$reference,
  top_k = 3L
)

posterior_final <- posterior_eval[posterior_eval$checkpoint == max(model_budgets), ]
posterior_final <- aggregate(
  posterior_final[, c(
    "top1_match",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "spearman",
    "share_best_truth",
    "allocation_entropy"
  )],
  by = list(allocation_policy = posterior_final$allocation_policy),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  posterior_final,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Posterior-family comparison at the largest budget."
)
```

```{r reward-compare}
reward_compare_1_6 <- bg_compare_reward_models(
  problems = problem_1_6,
  reward_model_map = c(
    scalar_payoff = "beta_pseudo",
    categorical_outcome = "dirichlet_multinomial",
    win_loss = "beta_bernoulli"
  ),
  budgets = model_budgets,
  seeds = model_seeds,
  allocation_policy = "thompson",
  reference_budget = truth_budget,
  save_path = reward_compare_path,
  overwrite = model_overwrite
)
```

```{r reward-summary}
knitr::kable(
  reward_compare_1_6$summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Reward-model stack comparison for canonical Thompson sampling."
)
```

```{r reward-eval}
reward_eval <- bg_eval_reference_aware(
  reward_compare_1_6,
  top_k = 3L
)

reward_final <- reward_eval[reward_eval$checkpoint == max(model_budgets), ]
reward_final <- aggregate(
  reward_final[, c(
    "top1_match",
    "simple_regret",
    "selected_reference_rank",
    "recommended_prob_best",
    "spearman",
    "share_best_truth",
    "allocation_entropy"
  )],
  by = list(allocation_policy = reward_final$allocation_policy),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  reward_final,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Reward-model stack comparison at the largest budget."
)
```

```{r posterior-regret-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_posterior_compare(
  posterior_compare_1_6,
  metric = "simple_regret"
)
```

```{r posterior-match-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_posterior_compare(
  posterior_compare_1_6,
  metric = "top1_match"
)
```

```{r reward-regret-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_posterior_compare(
  reward_compare_1_6,
  metric = "simple_regret"
)
```

```{r reward-rank-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_bg_posterior_compare(
  reward_compare_1_6,
  metric = "spearman"
)
```

```{r model-runtime-table}
posterior_runtime <- aggregate(
  posterior_compare_1_6$results[, c("runtime_seconds", "rollout_throughput")],
  by = list(
    allocation_policy = posterior_compare_1_6$results$allocation_policy,
    checkpoint = posterior_compare_1_6$results$checkpoint
  ),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

reward_runtime <- aggregate(
  reward_compare_1_6$results[, c("runtime_seconds", "rollout_throughput")],
  by = list(
    allocation_policy = reward_compare_1_6$results$allocation_policy,
    checkpoint = reward_compare_1_6$results$checkpoint
  ),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  posterior_runtime,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Runtime and throughput for the scalar posterior-family comparison."
)

knitr::kable(
  reward_runtime,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Runtime and throughput for the reward-model stack comparison."
)
```
